title: Bribery is asked once per voter
description: Felix (feedback fb_1792226954_3af06d0a, round 5 agenda, Letnev holding Bribery) was asked 'after VOTES_CAST' after every planet each other seat exhausted, not once per player. The engine's votes-cast window now opens once per voter (rules version 2); the web client has no change of its own: it shows the same reaction offer and the same one-count question, just once per voter. Real app against a mocked game.

shots.heading: The offer, once per voter
shots.caption: Bribery's window after a voter has voted. Under rules version 2 it opens once per voter, right after they name their outcome.

shots.heading: The question after playing it
shots.caption: One question: how many trade goods to spend (one extra vote each).

notes.title: Before and after in the stored game
notes.text: Round 5, seats a and b voting: the replay showed a reaction pause to Felix after a's outcome, after each of a's six planets, after b's outcome and after each of b's planets. Now: one per voter. The client's planet-exhaust batch is no longer interrupted by it either.

notes.title: Old games
notes.text: Games with rules version 0 or 1 replay as before (a window after every answer of the vote).
